title: AgentEvalSuite
description: A suite of agent eval scenarios, written as data: what a customer says, turn by turn, and what must hold after each turn. `@ouispec/agent-evals` runs every scenario on every channel the suite names, against the product's real agent configuration (persona, tools, tool policy, turn policy), from recorded model responses in CI or against the live model, and fails on any assertion that does not hold.

name.description: The suite's name, as reports show it.

channels.description: The channels every scenario runs on, as the eval configuration names them (`web_chat`, `sms`, `voice`). Default: every channel the configuration names.

context.description: What every turn of every scenario carries as its context, before the channel's and the scenario's own.

stubs.description: What each tool returns, for every scenario; a scenario's own stubs come first.

page.description: The person's page, scripted, for every scenario: what it offers at each address and what its actions do. Each turn is sent from it, and the agent's page actions are answered by it. A scenario's own `page` replaces it.

AgentEvalChannelList.description: Channel names, as the eval configuration names them.

AgentEvalScenario.description: One conversation: its turns in order, and what must hold after each.

id.description: Unique in the suite; names its recordings.

title.description: What it shows, as reports name it.

channels.description: The suite's channels this scenario runs on, when not all of them.

context.description: What each of its turns carries as its context, after the suite's and the channel's.

stubs.description: What each tool returns in this scenario, before the suite's stubs.

page.description: The page this scenario's turns are sent from, in place of the suite's; `false`: no page.

AgentEvalTurn.description: One step of a scenario: the customer says something, answers the waiting approval, or a person on the staff acts.

AgentEvalUserTurn.description: The customer's message: the agent's turn runs, and its expectations are checked.

AgentEvalApprovalTurn.description: The customer's answer to the approval the last turn stopped at, decided on the channel's approval channel (the card on `ui`; the readback and an affirmative message on a conversation channel). The continuation turn runs, and its expectations are checked.

AgentEvalStaffTurn.description: A person on the staff takes the conversation over, writes to the customer, or hands it back. No agent turn runs.

AgentEvalTextMatcher.description: What a reply's text is matched against: a string, found anywhere in it, ignoring case; a regular expression (`pattern`, with `flags`); or a `rubric`, which a judge model decides.

rubric.description: What the reply must do, in a sentence a judge reads.

AgentEvalToolCall.description: A tool the agent called: its name, and arguments its call holds (a subset: every key given, with an equal value; nested objects as subsets too).

AgentEvalApprovalExpectation.description: The turn stopped at a call that needs the customer's approval, with a readback present.

args.description: A subset of the call's arguments.

AgentEvalExpectation.description: What must hold after a turn. Every field given must hold.

toolCalled.description: Each was called, with these arguments.

toolNotCalled.description: None of these was called; `*` means no tool at all.

approvalRequested.description: The turn stopped for the customer's approval of this call; `false`: it did not stop for any.

refusal.description: The reply declines: `true` for the usual phrasing of a refusal (can't, cannot, unable, not able, won't, not allowed), or a matcher for the agent's own words.

doesNotStore.description: None of these appears in anything the turn stored: its text, its tool calls' arguments, its tool results.

held.description: `true`: the turn ran no model call, because a person held the conversation.

calls.description: How many times each tool, or each of the page's actions, was called in the turn.

usage.description: What the turn's model calls used, as the provider reported it.

choices.description: The turn offered the person choice buttons (`present_options`) that match; `false`: it offered none.

page.description: What the page did in the turn, read from the page itself.

AgentEvalExpectationsByChannel.description: What must also hold on one channel, by its name.

AgentEvalStubCase.description: What a tool returns when it is called with arguments that hold `when` (a subset; absent: any call).

AgentEvalStubs.description: What each tool returns, by tool name: its cases in order, the first that matches the call wins. A call to a tool with no matching case fails the scenario: an eval never reaches a real backend.

AgentEvalPage.description: The person's page, scripted. The harness runs it on a real oui-spec surface runtime in index form, sends each turn from where it is (its address and its snapshot, as the person's tab sends them), and answers the agent's page actions (`ui_act`, `ui_describe`, `ui_read`) from it. Its surfaces are declared here, or are the product's own: the controls of its generated manifest, given to the configuration (`page.manifest`), mounted as its tab mounts them.

at.description: The address the first turn is sent from. Each later turn is sent from wherever the page is by then.

routes.description: The addresses going to a page accepts, as route patterns (`/leads/:id`), when the manifest declares no navigation surface of its own. Default: every surface's routes, the manifest's pages, and `at`.

navigation.description: Whether the page offers going to a page by its address (`app.navigate`), as a generated app does: the manifest's navigation surface, or one made from `routes`, run by the bindings as the product's tab runs it. Default: true.

surfaces.description: Surfaces declared here, each mounted while the page is at one of its routes.

controls.description: The product's own controls, by binding id in the configuration's manifest: each is mounted while the page is on its surface, with what it shows and what it does.

allControls.description: Also mount every other control the manifest declares on a surface that is mounted, with no value, as an empty form shows them. A list's per-row controls are not: no row is rendered. Default: false.

AgentEvalPageSurface.description: A surface of the page: its actions, and what it reports.

routes.description: Where it is mounted, as route patterns. Absent: on every page, as a shell is.

state.description: What it reports when the page opens, by observation id.

AgentEvalPageAction.description: An action of a declared surface, and what it does when it runs.

id.description: As the page's index names it, and `ui_act` takes it.

confirm.description: It asks the person to approve it first.

input.description: What it takes, as a JSON Schema. Default: nothing.

result.description: What it answers. Default: it succeeds, returning nothing.

state.description: Its surface's observations once it has run, by observation id: each given replaces the one before.

navigate.description: The address the page goes to once it has run.

cases.description: What it does for a call whose input holds `when`, the first that matches; a call none matches gets the defaults beside them.

when.description: A subset of its input; absent: any call.

result.description: What it answers. Default: it succeeds, returning nothing.

state.description: Its surface's observations once it has run, by observation id: each given replaces the one before.

navigate.description: The address the page goes to once it has run.

AgentEvalPageControl.description: One of the product's controls, as the page shows it, and what it does when it runs (default: it takes the value it is given, and succeeds).

value.description: What it shows when the page opens. A run sets it to the value it was given.

title.description: What it is called on screen. Default: the manifest's title.

valueSchema.description: Its live value schema (its options, its range), within the manifest's.

disabled.description: It cannot be used: it is not offered.

rows.description: For a list's control: one per row shown.

routes.description: Where it is mounted, when not wherever its surface is.

result.description: What it answers. Default: it succeeds, returning nothing.

navigate.description: The address the page goes to once it has run.

cases.description: What it does for a call whose input holds `when`, the first that matches; a call none matches gets the defaults beside them.

when.description: A subset of its input; absent: any call.

result.description: What it answers. Default: it succeeds, returning nothing.

navigate.description: The address the page goes to once it has run.

AgentEvalBound.description: A number at least `min` and at most `max`.

AgentEvalShareBound.description: A share, from 0 to 1, at least `min` and at most `max`.

AgentEvalCallCount.description: The calls of one tool (`tool`), or of one of the page's actions run through `ui_act` (`action`, by its id or the name the page's index gives it), whose arguments (a tool's) or input (an action's) hold `args` as a subset, counted: exactly `times`, or at least `min` and at most `max`. With none of the three: at least once.

AgentEvalUsage.description: Bounds on what the turn's model calls used, as the provider reported it. Every bound given must hold.

modelCalls.description: How many model calls the turn made.

firstCallInputTokens.description: The input tokens of the turn's first model call: what the turn costs before it has done anything.

callInputTokens.description: The input tokens of every one of the turn's model calls: `max` holds the largest, `min` the smallest.

inputTokens.description: The input tokens of all the turn's model calls together.

outputTokens.description: The output tokens of all the turn's model calls together.

cachedShare.description: The share of the turn's input tokens read from the prompt cache.

AgentEvalChoicesExpectation.description: The choice buttons the turn offered (`present_options`).

options.description: Each matches one option offered: its label, or its label and description.

question.description: Each matches what is asked with them: the question, and what it says before it.

AgentEvalPageExpectation.description: What the page did in the turn: where it is, and what ran on it.

at.description: Where the page is after the turn: this path, and each query parameter given with the value given.

ran.description: Each ran on the page in the turn (by its id or its index name), its input holding `input` as a subset.

notRan.description: None of these ran on the page in the turn; `*`: nothing did.
